name: Power Substation
instruction: Hello! I need a 3D model of a power substation. The substation should include transformers, circuit breakers, and busbars. There should be high-voltage transmission lines entering and exiting the substation. The layout should be realistic and functional for distributing electricity.

Shape accuracy: The shape of the power substation is not specified in the instruction but the components in the substation should be similar to the reality.
Color representation: The color set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Size: The size set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Proportion: The components of the power substation are proportioante to the entire substation.
Texture and surface detail: The texture and surface detail set in the script is reasonable for the object.

Three-dimensional spatial awareness: The transformers are spaced adequately for maintenance.
The circuit breakers are positioned for easy access.
The busbars are aligned with the transformers and circuit breakers.
Object distance and contact: There is no overlap between the transformers and circuit breakers.
The transmission lines are appropriately elevated above the substation components.

Instruction execution accuracy: All specified components (transformers, circuit breakers, busbars) are included.
The layout is functional for electricity distribution as requested.
